title: A customer's order goes through the portal and back
goal: An orderer of a customer sends an order from the customer portal; the staffing company's coordinator staffs the job it became and confirms it; the orderer sees the order confirmed with the staff member's name; a second order is canceled from the portal while it waits, and the staffing company's job is canceled with it.

actors.description: Riley Quinn, an orderer of Brightpath Learning, the customer whose portal Company A runs.
Casey Lind of Company A, who staffs the jobs customers send.

preconditions: The end-to-end database was prepared in this run: Company A with the coordinator Casey Lind and the qualified staff member Jamie Fors, its active customer Brightpath Learning whose portal Company A enabled, the service Classroom assistant it offers in that portal, and that portal's customer administrator and orderer, all set up through the services.

steps.intent: Write an order in the portal, ask for two people of a service the staffing company offers, and send it
steps.outcome: The order is sent, and the staffing company has a job waiting for coordination for the customer, with a slot for each person made from its service.

steps.intent: Complete the job that arrived with a weekly time, start staffing it and assign a qualified staff member to one of its two slots
steps.outcome: The job is being staffed and one of its slots is covered by the assigned staff member.
The job is confirmed with its staff member.

steps.intent: Look at the order in the portal
steps.outcome: The order reads confirmed and names the staff member, and nothing else of the staffing company.

steps.intent: Send a second order and cancel it from the portal while it waits
steps.outcome: The order reads "Cancellation sent"; the staffing company's job for it is canceled by the customer, the coordinator is told, and the order then reads canceled by us.

completion: An order sent from the portal became a job the staffing company staffed and confirmed, and the portal shows its staff member.
An order canceled from the portal canceled its job in the staffing company, and both sides end canceled.
Every job the run made is canceled on its way out, so its staff member is free for the next run.
